# `silk/markdown/html`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

HTML output for Markdown trees, with escaped raw HTML and filtered destinations by default.

## When to use

Use `MarkdownHtml.renderOwned` for owned text, `renderInto` for a reusable buffer, or `renderToWriter` for streaming output.

## Details

Rendering walks tree links iteratively and allocates no storage per node.
Default options escape raw HTML and empty destinations with javascript, vbscript, file, or data schemes.

## Examples

### Render a link with a filtered destination

```silk
import silk.markdown.document { MarkdownDocument }
import silk.markdown.html { MarkdownHtml }
import silk.text.string { String }
import silk.core.effect { Effect }
import silk.mem.allocator { Allocator, OutOfMemoryError }

pub effect fn main() -> i32
  ! OutOfMemoryError {
  let mut allocator = Allocator.systemAllocatorProvider()
  let document = run MarkdownDocument.parse("[open](javascript:alert)")
    |> Effect.provideMut<Allocator>(&mut allocator)
  let output = run MarkdownHtml.renderOwned(&document)
    |> Effect.provideMut<Allocator>(&mut allocator)
  if String.view(&output) != "<p><a href=\"\">open</a></p>\n" {
    return 1
  }
  return 0
}
```

<a id="HtmlOptions"></a>

## `HtmlOptions`

```silk
pub struct HtmlOptions
```

The HTML rendering policy. The defaults escape raw HTML and filter dangerous destination schemes.

<a id="HtmlOptions.rawHtml"></a>

### Field `rawHtml`

```silk
pub rawHtml: bool
```

Emits raw HTML verbatim when true. The default is false, which escapes raw HTML as text.

<a id="HtmlOptions.unsafeLinks"></a>

### Field `unsafeLinks`

```silk
pub unsafeLinks: bool
```

Allows javascript, vbscript, file, and data destinations when true. The default is false.
Filtering ignores ASCII case, leading control bytes, and tabs or line endings within a scheme.

<a id="HtmlOptions.headingIds"></a>

### Field `headingIds`

```silk
pub headingIds: bool
```

Emits unique GitHub-style heading ids when true. The default is false.
Slug state starts empty for each render operation and follows rendered heading order.

<a id="MarkdownHtml.impl.renderNodeInto"></a>

### Associated function `renderNodeInto`

```silk
pub effect fn renderNodeInto(
    document: &MarkdownDocument<'_>,
    id: MarkdownNodeId,
    out: &mut Bytes,
  ) -> ()
    ! OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Appends the HTML of subtree `id` to `out` with raw HTML escaped and dangerous schemes filtered.
Invalid ids append nothing. List paragraphs follow their containing list's tightness.

#### Errors

- `OutOfMemoryError` if the output cannot grow. Bytes already appended remain in `out`.

<a id="MarkdownHtml.impl.renderToWriter"></a>

### Associated function `renderToWriter`

```silk
pub effect fn renderToWriter(document: &MarkdownDocument<'_>) -> ()
    ! WriterError | OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Writer | &mut Allocator
```

Writes HTML with raw HTML escaped and dangerous schemes filtered. Does not flush the writer.
Heading ids allocate slug state only when enabled.

#### Errors

- `WriterError` if the writer fails. Bytes already accepted remain written.
- `OutOfMemoryError` if enabled heading-id storage cannot grow. Earlier output remains written.
